Exact TDNN rank-weight table (Demirkaya two-scale DNN, k = 1)

tdnn_rank_table_exact.Rd

Computes the rank-order weight sequence for the two-scale DNN (TDNN) estimator of Demirkaya et al. as a signed linear combination of two exact single-scale DNN rank-weight tables evaluated at (k=1, s1) and (k=1, s2):

Usage

tdnn_rank_table_exact(n, s1, s2, dim)

Arguments

n

Positive integer; sample size.

s1

Positive integer; smaller U-statistic order (s1 < s2 <= n).

s2

Positive integer; larger U-statistic order (s1 < s2 <= n).

dim

Positive integer; localization dimension (typically ncol(X)).

Value

A numeric vector of length n giving the rank-order TDNN weights w_rank[1:n] (rank 1 = nearest). Entries sum to 1 but some can be negative.

Details

$$w^{\text{TDNN}}_j = w_1^* \, w^{\text{DNN}}_j(s_1) + w_2^* \, w^{\text{DNN}}_j(s_2)$$

with bias-correction scalars $$w_1^* = \frac{1}{1 - (s_1/s_2)^{-2/d}}, \quad w_2^* = 1 - w_1^*,$$ where \(d\) is the localization dimension.

Note: TDNN weights are signed. They sum to 1 but individual entries can be negative (specifically, ranks near 1 receive negative weight from the \(s_1\) term). This is by design: the signed combination cancels the leading bias term in the DNN MSE expansion.

See also

tdnn_rank_table_asymp(), dnn_weights_tdnn_exact_full_from_ranks(), rank_weight_tdnn_exact()

Examples

n <- 20; s1 <- 3L; s2 <- 6L; d <- 2L
w <- tdnn_rank_table_exact(n, s1, s2, d)
sum(w)          # 1
#> [1] 1
any(w < 0)      # TRUE (bias-correction weights)
#> [1] TRUE
